in_marathi.name: Parash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘पराश्पति’ (Parashpati), meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Parashpati is a god of wealth and knowledge, and is also known as the god of healing.

in_bengali.name: Parash
in_bengali.long_meaning: Parash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘पराश्पति’ (Parashpati), meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Parashpati is a god of wealth and knowledge, and is also known as the god of healing.
